answer: Zero-knowledge uniqueness proofs curb Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to derive a deterministic nullifier from an attested human credential before taking meadow ecology, nectar assay, or solar zenith jobs. Because the registry allows one key per epoch nullifier without exposing private data, attackers incur the cost of recruiting distinct verified individuals per clone. Still, credential-rental markets and rogue issuers can supply multiple valid identities.
